sources: Hedges, Tipton & Johnson (2010), Robust variance estimation in meta-regression with dependent effect size estimates, DOI 10.1002/jrsm.5
Pustejovsky & Tipton (2021), Meta-analysis with Robust Variance Estimation: Expanding the Range of Working Models
entries.projection: Nominally different estimates can be statistically dependent because they reuse the same individuals, samples, study, laboratory or related data-generating structure. Dependence should be modeled rather than converted into extra precision by counting labels.
entries.rakl_absorption: Split independent-flat authority into process/context independence and evidence-lineage independence. Full saturation credit is conservative under shared ancestry; shared lineage does not become a new independent observation merely because a different paper, route or agent reports it.
entries.scope_limit: Shared ancestry need not imply zero incremental information. RAKL v1 therefore computes a conservative full-independence lower bound and leaves graded/effective dependence for a future covariance/causal model rather than inventing fractional credit.

entries.projection: Provenance is a graph of entities, activities, agents and derivations, with explicit relations for derivation and mechanisms for provenance-of-provenance and alternate/specialized entities.
entries.rakl_absorption: Evidence independence should be computed from declared ancestry/derivation coordinates rather than source names alone. The initial executable layer uses canonical lineage IDs; a fuller provenance DAG can later distinguish raw datasets, transformations, analyses and derived evidence packets.
entries.scope_limit: A provenance edge documents ancestry, not truth, reliability or the magnitude of statistical dependence.

entries.projection: Operational lineage distinguishes jobs from runs, records input/output datasets and versions/facets, and uses consistent naming strategies so observed execution ancestry can be reconstructed across systems.
entries.rakl_absorption: RAKL lineage should eventually be versioned at the evidence-artifact level instead of treating one paper/source ID as the lineage atom. Dataset identity, version, transformation/run and derived artifact are separate coordinates.
entries.scope_limit: OpenLineage is designed for data pipelines, not scientific epistemic independence; its identity model is a useful chart, not a complete evidence model.

entries.source_family: GitHub Actions pull-request execution semantics plus native round-005 trace
entries.projection: For pull_request workflows GitHub's merge ref / GITHUB_SHA identifies a synthesized merge subject, whereas workflow/check-suite head_sha identifies the source head. Default checkout tests the merge result unless explicitly directed to the source head.
entries.rakl_absorption: META_N024 remains open and is now more sharply typed: source-head identity, base identity, integration/merge identity and executed identity are separate coordinates. An attestation must say which subject each verdict actually covers.
entries.scope_limit: Round 006 did not activate a new promotion authority for integration identity. Public run/check-suite metadata alone was not treated as proof of the exact executed merge subject.

new_atomic_gaps_after_dedup.gap: Two lineage strings can refer to the same underlying dataset/artifact/version; string-disjoint IDs can therefore fake evidence independence unless aliases and versions are normalized.

Known shared lineage establishes non-independence but does not by itself identify its strength. Fractional/effective information credit requires covariance, overlap, causal or hierarchical structure rather than an arbitrary scalar penalty.
